findings.title: Explicit sensitive questions still reach the LLM
findings.evidence: A narrow browser-free check returned false for explicit work-authorization, salary, legal/background, and demographic questions. Classifier misses without a matching bank pattern fall through to the LLM, whose FormAnswer schema requires a non-empty answer.
findings.consequence: The LLM can fill protected answers, violating R15.5's never-LLM requirement.
findings.correction: Route conservative protected-category variants to the bank-only-or-blank path and add zero-LLM regressions for the demonstrated phrasings.

findings.title: Real radio labels and required-group state are still modeled incorrectly
findings.evidence: Production stores each radio submit value as both label and value, so an approved visible answer such as No cannot match true/false values. Required validation checks one real radio at a time, while the fake substitutes a pseudo group control whose checked state becomes true when any sibling is selected.
findings.consequence: A usable approved bank answer can remain blank, and a correctly selected required radio group can still abort on a real form.
findings.correction: Read associated labels for every radio, retain label/value/selector separately, validate required radios once per name group by checking any real member, and make the fake expose actual sibling semantics.

findings.title: A CAPTCHA detected after the click releases an ambiguous submit claim
findings.evidence: After dispatching the submit click, post-submit CAPTCHA detection raises CaptchaError. The caller releases the durable claim for every CaptchaError, unlike SubmitAmbiguousError.
findings.consequence: If the site accepted the form before showing the challenge, a later retry can submit a duplicate application.
findings.correction: Stop and notify, but classify a CAPTCHA first observed after click dispatch as ambiguous and retain the claim; release only pre-dispatch CAPTCHA stops or outcomes proving non-acceptance.

findings.title: Browser interaction failures during filling bypass safe-abort notification
findings.evidence: Profile fill, upload, select, radio, and question interactions can raise Playwright errors after a control detaches or rerenders, but the local caller catches only CaptchaError and FormStructureError around fill_page.
findings.consequence: The browser closes and the CLI reports a generic failure without the required abort screenshot or Telegram notification for unexpected DOM changes.
findings.correction: Convert pre-submit Playwright interaction and DOM errors into the safe-abort path while the page remains open, preserving no-click behavior and sending the screenshot and notification.
